source_caption:
In one of Game of Thrones’ most heartbreaking confessions, Catelyn Stark admits to Talisa Stark that she couldn’t bring herself to love a motherless child and blamed herself for all the tragedy that followed because she broke her promise to the gods. The most painful part? Jon Snow spent his entire youth feeling like an unwanted outsider in Winterfell, never once getting to hear that the woman who resented him actually regretted it.

The ultimate tragedy is the truth she died without ever knowing: Ned Stark never betrayed her. Jon wasn’t the living proof of her husband's infidelity, he was Lyanna’s son, the rightful heir Ned sacrificed his own honor to protect. Catelyn carried the weight of a betrayal that never happened, and Jon carried the shame of a sin that wasn’t his.

Which Game of Thrones tragedy still hits you the hardest? Drop your thoughts below!
